import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
trace,intake,response=map(Path,sys.argv[1:4])
expected_hash=sys.argv[4]
try:
    assert hashlib.sha256(response.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected_hash, 'saved_response_changed'
    expected=json.loads(intake.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    chunks={}; ends=[]; chunk_count=0
    for line in trace.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
        row=json.loads(line); p=row.get('payload',{})
        if row.get('type')!='response_item' or p.get('type') not in {'function_call_output','custom_tool_call_output'}: continue
        out=p.get('output'); parts=[out] if isinstance(out,str) else [v.get('text','') for v in out if isinstance(v,dict)]
        for text in parts:
            head,sep,body=text.partition('\n')
            try: meta=json.loads(head)
            except ValueError: continue
            if not isinstance(meta,dict): continue
            if 'intake_end' in meta: ends.append(meta['intake_end'])
            if not {'section','from_character','to_character','total_characters'}<=meta.keys(): continue
            chunk_count+=1; name=meta['section']
            marker='\nEND_SECTION_BLOCK '+name+' '+str(meta['to_character'])
            assert body.endswith(marker), 'section_end_marker_mismatch'
            body=body[:-len(marker)]
            assert name in expected['content'], 'unexpected_section'
            previous=chunks.get(name,'')
            assert len(previous.encode('utf-16-le'))//2==meta['from_character'], 'intake_gap_or_overlap'
            assert meta['total_characters']==len(expected['content'][name].encode('utf-16-le'))//2, 'section_size_changed'
            assert meta['to_character']==len((previous+body).encode('utf-16-le'))//2, 'chunk_size_mismatch'
            chunks[name]=previous+body
    assert ends==[expected['intake_end']], 'end_marker_not_exactly_once'
    assert chunks==expected['content'], 'intake_content_or_section_missing'
    assert {k:len(v.encode('utf-8')) for k,v in chunks.items()}==expected['content_bytes'], 'intake_bytes_mismatch'
    print(json.dumps({'check':'exact_intake_and_saved_response','status':'passed','sections':len(chunks),'chunks':chunk_count,'content_bytes':sum(expected['content_bytes'].values()),'semantic_quality':'not_reassessed'}))
except (AssertionError,ValueError,OSError,TypeError) as exc:
    print(json.dumps({'check':'exact_intake_and_saved_response','status':'failed','reason':str(exc)}))
    raise SystemExit(7)
